name: dialog
description: Accessible modal dialog with focus trap/restore, backdrop and Escape dismissal, size presets, optional header/footer slots, a scrollable body, and opt-in fade motion.
designIntent: Modals interrupt the task flow on purpose: confirmations, small forms, and destructive-action guards. The Dialog implements the full modal contract — aria-modal labelling, initial focus, a Tab focus trap, Escape and backdrop dismissal, and focus restoration to the opener — so consumers never hand-roll focus management.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the user requests open/close (escape, backdrop, close button)

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name + default header title. Optional when composing a custom header with ariaLabel.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional supporting text, wired via aria-describedby

props.name: closeOnBackdrop
props.description: Whether clicking the backdrop closes the dialog

props.name: initialFocusRef
props.description: Element focused on open; defaults to the first focusable element

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the dialog (required for screen readers)

props.name: showClose
props.description: Hide the close (?) button in the header; Escape and backdrop still close.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the close button.

props.name: animate
props.description: Fade the backdrop and panel in/out on open/close (needs tailwindcss-animate; reduced motion respected).

props.name: header
props.description: Replaces the default header row — compose with DialogHeader/DialogTitle/DialogDescription (ids wire automatically).

props.name: footer
props.description: Action row pinned under the body.

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Caps the body height and scrolls inside the panel.

props.name: bodyClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the body wrapper.

examples.title: Destructive confirmation
examples.description: Controlled dialog; the opener keeps the open state.

antiPatterns.title: Do not open a dialog without a focusable control
antiPatterns.explanation: Users must be able to act or dismiss without a mouse. Always include at least one button inside the dialog body.

accessibility.implementation: role=dialog with aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby from the title, and aria-describedby when a description is provided.
Initial focus moves into the dialog; Tab wraps between focusable elements; focus returns to the opener on close.
Escape closes the dialog via the onOpenChange callback.

compositionRules.relationship: Dialog footers use Button for primary/secondary actions.
